triggers.name: new_event
triggers.title: New event
triggers.help: Triggers when webhooks sent from Greenhouse. First, select a Greenhouse object, then select the event you want to trigger this recipe and configure these webhooks in Greenhouse to match the webhook URL endpoint given below. Connect to Greenhouse to get endpoint URL for Greenhouse.

input.name: object
input.label: Event category
input.hint: Select the object type from picklist.

input.name: event_type
input.label: Event
input.hint: Select specific event.

input.name: webhook_secret_key
input.label: Secret key
input.hint: Provide a randomly generated value at least 32 characters in length. Use this secret key to setup the webhook in Greenhouse. Learn more

triggers.name: new_object_v3
triggers.title: New object (v3)
triggers.description: New object in Greenhouse using v3
triggers.help: Triggers when a new object is created in Greenhouse using v3.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the object to poll (same choices as the v2 New object trigger, using Harvest v3).

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: When you start recipe for the first time, it picks up trigger events from this specified date and time. Leave empty to get records created one hour ago. Once recipe has been run or tested, value canno…

triggers.name: new_or_updated_objects_batch_v3
triggers.title: New/updated object (v3)
triggers.description: New/updated object in Greenhouse using v3
triggers.help: Triggers when the selected object in Greenhouse using v3 is created or updated.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the object to poll (same choices as the v2 New/updated object trigger, using Harvest v3).

input.name: from
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: When you start recipe for the first time, it picks up trigger events from this specified date and time. Leave empty to get records created or updated one hour ago.

input.name: batch_size
input.label: Batch size
input.hint: Maximum number of records per trigger event. Minimum is 1, maximum is 500 , default is 500 .

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Greenhouse action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Greenhouse connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: create_attachment_v3
actions.title: Create attachment (v3)
actions.description: Create attachment in Greenhouse using v3 endpoint
actions.help: Create an attachment for an application using the Greenhouse v3 endpoint. This action is available for OAuth 2.0 connections only.

input.name: content
input.label: File content
input.hint: Map the raw file contents. Use this field or provide URL.

input.name: url
input.label: File URL
input.hint: Provide the URL to the file. Use this field or provide file content.

input.name: visibility
input.label: Visibility
input.hint: The visibility setting on the attachment.

actions.name: create_object_v3_post
actions.title: Create object (v3)
actions.help: Create a candidate, application, note, education, employment record, job, or user using Greenhouse v3 endpoints. This action is available for OAuth 2.0 connections only.

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select object type for v3 POST endpoint.

actions.name: mark_candidate_hire_v3
actions.title: Mark candidate as hired (v3)
actions.description: Mark candidate as hired in Greenhouse using v3 endpoint
actions.help: Mark an application as hired using the Greenhouse v3 endpoint. This action is available for OAuth 2.0 connections only.

input.name: start_date
input.label: Start date
input.hint: Start date of the employee.

input.name: opening_id
input.label: Opening ID
input.hint: Opening ID to fill with this hire.

actions.name: move_application_v3
actions.title: Move application (v3)
actions.description: Move application in Greenhouse using v3 OAuth endpoint
actions.help: Move an application to a different stage within the same job or transfer it to another job using the Greenhouse v3 endpoint. This action is available for OAuth 2.0 connections only.

input.name: from_stage_id
input.label: From stage ID
input.hint: The ID of the stage the application is currently in.

input.name: to_stage_id
input.label: To stage ID
input.hint: The ID of the stage to move the application to.

input.name: to_job_id
input.label: To job ID
input.hint: Provide to transfer the application to another job.

input.name: email_from_user_id
input.label: Email from user ID
input.hint: User ID used as the sender for move notification email.

actions.name: reject_application_v3
actions.title: Reject application (v3)
actions.description: Reject application in Greenhouse using v3 endpoint
actions.help: Reject an application using the Greenhouse v3 endpoint. This action is available for OAuth 2.0 connections only.

input.name: notes
input.label: Notes
input.hint: Notes on why this application is rejected. This will be added to the activity feed.

input.name: send_email_at
input.label: Send email at
input.hint: When present, rejection email can be sent at this time.

input.name: email_from_user_id
input.label: Email from user ID
input.hint: User ID to use as sender for rejection email.

actions.name: search_object_v3
actions.title: Search objects (v3)
actions.description: Search objects from selected Greenhouse v3 endpoint
actions.help: Search for candidates, applications, jobs, users, etc in Greenhouse v3 API.

input.name: endpoint
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the object type from picklist.

actions.name: update_object_v3_patch
actions.title: Update object (v3)
actions.help: Update a candidate, application, job, or user using Greenhouse v3 endpoints. This action is available for OAuth 2.0 connections only.

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select object type for v3 PATCH endpoint.
